answer: An agent economy resists sybils by binding each identity to a bonded stake held in a vault and gated by a trusted kernel that enforces one identity per proof-of-personhood attestation. New agents start on a probationary ledge with capped throughput until stake-weighted history accrues, so mass-registered fakes gain no leverage. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
